bound_qualification: Publicly unreachable32-node/32-edge-path boundaries are not falsely tested via malformed larger Bodies. Explicit path vectors and trigger assignments are handwritten from finite labeled graphs; no future checker output used.

cases.manual_rationale: No declared update seeds: every complete declared closure unchanged.
Old-source replacement reaches A directly and B through labeled Claim dependency; C stays unchanged.
Withdrawal remains an informational old-version seed, not source deletion or truth negation.
Identical effects with distinct event IDs do not conflict or disappear; each ID retains a labeled path.
Replacement and withdrawal of identical old key conflict; affected Claims require revalidation with CONFLICT.
Different predecessors do not suppress conflict for identical old key and different effect. Identical root withdrawals retain their own IDs but do not reach old-source Claims.
Parallel endpoint edges retain distinct Dependency-ID path evidence.
Equal physical source copies count separately at source boundary but produce one complete-key graph node, no duplicate path.
Exact prior-event bytes identify already-recorded ID while that event remains a normal impact seed.
Two distinct history records preserve both IDs; already-recorded event ID set remains unique.
Non-event history artifact stays opaque; classification and related_record_ids original order are preserved.
A history SourceKey cannot be resolved from a label alone.
Correctly self-bound artifact bytes unequal to canonical supplied events cannot claim prior update identity.
Separately supplied event pin set may not be filled from candidate UpdateNotice.
Every complete canonical event byte string must match its separately frozen held pin.
Bool is not a builtin integer byte_length.
Held count above8 refuses before examining malformed items.
Candidate and separately held event ID preserve pinned finalLF pattern-search semantics; no stronger fullmatch.
Builtin integer above held byte_length cap is a shape/range refusal before event-pin matching.
Every graph component is checked, with no seed-dependent cycle bypass.
CLAIM target needs an actual id/revision, not only a well-shaped ClaimKey.
A supplied label with wrong complete canonical Claim digest is refused.
Unused source-target dependency cannot be silently ignored.
Missing predecessor must not become a root.
Symbolic self predecessor is a real finite canonical fixture and must refuse cycle.
Old SourceKey logical identity must equal notice logical_source_id.
Evidence pin binds complete canonical UPDATE_EVIDENCE Blob record, not decoded payload.
Changing Blob kind with same valid payload invalidates its held record pin before kind classification.
Changing Blob encoding with same valid payload invalidates complete record pin.
Even a correct complete record pin cannot make PROMPT an UPDATE_EVIDENCE record.
Explicit bounded labeled path table at inclusive per-Claim cap remains complete.
Repeated identical-effect notices retain trigger identity; discovery beyond per-Claim path cap across both triggers refuses without prefix.

custody_qualification: Pins are authored developmental fixtures, frozen separately before product execution; matching cannot establish independent custody. Missing-pin controls are never filled from candidate at runtime.
